name: Gunsmoke
description: Gunsmoke is an American radio and television Western drama series created by director Norman MacDonnell and writer John Meston. The stories take place in and around Dodge City, Kansas, during the settlement of the American West. The central character is lawman Marshal Matt Dillon, played by William Conrad on radio and James Arness on television.

videos.title: Gunsmoke: Return to Dodge
videos.overview: Gunsmoke: Return to Dodge is the first TV-movie based on the 20-year television version of Gunsmoke starring James Arness. Although it is supposed to be set in the wilds of Kansas it was filmed in Alberta, Canada.

videos.title: Gunsmoke: The Last Apache
videos.overview: Gunsmoke: The Last Apache is a 1990 film directed by Charles Correll.

videos.title: Gunsmoke: To the Last Man
videos.overview: Gunsmoke: To the Last Man is a 1992 TV-movie starring James Arness as retired Marshal Matt Dillon and featuring Pat Hingle. Hapless rustlers make the fatal mistake of stealing Matt Dillon's cattle and Dillon blunders into the gory Pleasant Valley War during the process of hunting them down and killing two of them. The film, set in the 1880s, was directed by Jerry Jameson and based upon the long-running American television series Gunsmoke. The supporting cast includes Matt Mulhern as Will McCall, Joseph Bottoms as villainous Tommy Graham, and Morgan Woodward as Sheriff Abel Rose.

videos.title: Gunsmoke : The Long Ride
videos.overview: Gunsmoke: The Long Ride is a 1993 western TV series based on the popular series Gunsmoke, in which the main character, Matt Dillon is again played by James Arness.

videos.title: Gunsmoke: One Man's Justice
videos.overview: After his mother is killed in a wagoncoach robbery a young man pursues the gang responsible. Matt Dillon goes after him hoping to stop him before the gang can kill him. Dillon is joined by Davis Healy, a businessman, who is hiding a few secrets of his own.

videos.title: Remembering James Arness
videos.overview: A brief look at James Arness in the role of Matt Dillon through short excerpts and behind the scenes moments in the filming of Gunsmoke.

videos.title: Matt Gets It
videos.overview: Dan Grat, a gunman hunted by Texas authorities, seeks refuge in Dodge City. Marshal Dillon goes into action against this outlaw who shoots before he talks.

videos.title: Hot Spell
videos.overview: Matt intercedes on behalf of ex-con Cope Borden, when Rance Bradley accuses Cope of horse theft and attempts to lynch him. Cope is proven innocent of the charge, but later kills Bradley's nephew in a fair fight during a gambling dispute. Matt is caught in an awkward situation when he must defend the unsavory Cope against the decent people of Dodge.

videos.title: Word of Honor
videos.overview: Hank Worth, son of wealthy rancher Jake Worth, is kidnapped by three men and held for $20,000 ransom. They shoot him in the back for trying to escape. They call on Doc but Hank dies. The killers decide to let Doc go because he is the only doctor within 400 miles and they fear they might need his services someday. Before sparing his life and freeing him, they force the reluctant Doc to give his word of honor that he will never reveal their identities.

videos.title: Home Surgery
videos.overview: When returning to Dodge, Chester and Matt are confronted by Holly Hawtree, whose father is desperately ill with gangrene. His only hope for survival is amputation of the affected leg. Matt performs the surgery, but the gangrene has spread too far and the old man dies. Matt later discovers that the presumed accident leading to Mr. Hawtree's condition was actually caused by Ben Walling, who has his sights on Holly.

videos.title: Obie Tater
videos.overview: Two outlaws seek the rumored hidden fortune of old prospector Obie.  They drag him to get him to tell.  Obie forgets his cares and disappears on honeymoon with newcomer Ella May.  Matt suspiciously questions the simple Obie about Ella May's motives and finds Obie is deeper than he seems.

videos.title: Night Incident
videos.overview: Little Timmy Wyatt witnesses a series of bizarre murders.  He has a habit of telling tall tales, so no one will believe him.

videos.title: Smoking Out the Nolans
videos.overview: Clay Young is trying to evict Josh Nolan, who says he paid for the property. Matt and Chester are tied up in reluctantly enforcing eviction law unless they can find another way.

videos.title: Kite's Reward
videos.overview: Matt warns skilled gunman Andy Travis, of his choice between quitting the gun or else being constantly hunted and forced to prove himself.  Matt finds a way to foil the $1000 bounty on Andy's head.

videos.title: The Hunter
videos.overview: Buffalo hunter Jase Murdock is warned by storekeeper Ross to stay out of Indian territory. Matt talks with Murdock's skinner, Golden Calf, who determines that Murdock's medicine is no longer good.

videos.title: The Queue
videos.overview: Two bullies cut off Chen's pig-tail, gravely dishonoring him in Chinese culture. Chen vows vengeance.

videos.title: General Parsley Smith
videos.overview: Old-timer Smith is a former Army officer considered a butcher. He arrives in Dodge City speading rumors about the new Banker, Drew Holt.

videos.title: Magnus
videos.overview: Chester is embarrassed at a visit by his estranged mountain man brother Magnus. To prove that Magnus is too uncivilized for town, Chester tours him through the highlights of Dodge: card gambling, drinking, and talking with Kitty. Meanwhile, the Long Branch women plan a Christmas Eve dance which is busted by the spiteful Lucifer Jones.

videos.title: Reed Survives
videos.overview: Lucy professes her love for handsome Booth Rider, and concocts a scheme against Ephram.  Booth becomes the unwitting pawn in a homicide that culminates in an ironic twist of fate.

videos.title: Professor Lute Bone
videos.overview: Doc is enraged by traveling medicine man Professor Lute Bone and his opium elixir, and digs up a gun to shoot him with.  A lad also hunts him because his father died drinking his elixir, so Bone reconsiders the patent medicine business.

videos.title: No Handcuffs
videos.overview: A dishonest deputy sheriff steals a prisoner from Matt's jail, so Matt and Chester hunt them.

videos.title: Reward for Matt
videos.overview: Matt kills a man and his widow posts a $1,000 bounty in vengeance.  Everyone from sodbusters to gunslingers are out for that reward.

videos.title: Robin Hood
videos.overview: Witnesses refuse to testify against a notorious outlaw.

videos.title: Yorky
videos.overview: Yorky, a white boy who was brought up by Arapahoes, is victimized by horse thieves. Accused of their crime, he is shot by the vengeful Abe Brandt and his son. Matt is also targeted by the horse thieves.
A former lawman tries to keep his failing eyesight a secret from his enemies.

videos.title: Reunion '78
videos.overview: A well-liked hardware drummer is actually a man wanted for multiple murders.

videos.title: Helping Hand
videos.overview: A would-be tough guy picks on the wrong man in an attempt to make a name for himself when he tries to involve Marshal Matt Dillon by staging a street fight.

videos.title: Tap Day for Kitty
videos.overview: An old sodbuster comes to town and decides he wants to marry Kitty. When he won't leave her alone she declares she'll shoot him if he pesters her anymore.

videos.title: Indian Scout
videos.overview: When an old Indian scout (Eduard Franz) murders a man (DeForest Kelley), Matt pursues him into Comanche territory.

videos.title: The Pest Hole
videos.overview: Doc must find a way to thwart a typhoid epidemic in Dodge (Howard McNear appears).

videos.title: The Big Broad
videos.overview: Matt has to figure a way around a six-foot-tall, 200-pound woman with a six-gun.

videos.title: Hack Prine
videos.overview: Hack Prine, a friend of Matt's rides into Dodge. However he is there as a gunman, for Matt Dillon.

videos.title: Cooter
videos.overview: A dishonest gambler (Vinton Hayworth) uses a mentally challenged man (Strother Martin) in a plot against Matt (Robert Vaughn appears).

videos.title: The Killer
videos.overview: Charles Bronson guest stars as a cowardly gunslinger who only goes after old men or young kids who aren't very experienced with guns.  But, when Matt Dillon gives him an ultimatum, he shows his true colors.

videos.title: Doc's Revenge
videos.overview: A stranger comes to Dodge, and Doc bewilders and dismays Chester and Matt by arming himself and vowing to kill the man.

videos.title: The Preacher
videos.overview: Seth, a newcomer to Dodge is bullied by Keeler, a boxer.

videos.title: How to Die for Nothing
videos.overview: The brother of a man Matt was forced to kill vows to kill Matt by any means necessary (Mort Mills appears).

videos.title: Dutch George
videos.overview: Matt's Childhood hero, Dutch George is now the leader of a notorious gang of horse thieves he must now stop.

videos.title: Prairie Happy
videos.overview: A bitter old man spreads rumors of an impending Indian raid on Dodge.

videos.title: Chester's Mail Order Bride
videos.overview: When Chester's mail-order bride arrives, neither she nor Chester are what the other are expecting (first credited appearance of Bert Rumsey as 'Sam').

videos.title: The Guitar
videos.overview: An ex-Union soldier is forced to use violence against a pair of diehard Rebels (Jacques Aubuchon appears). First episode without the "Boot Hill" intro.

videos.title: Cara
videos.overview: Matt encounters an ex-girl friend---who's now working on the wrong side of the law.

videos.title: Mr. and Mrs. Amber
videos.overview: A self-styled religious prophet (Ainslie Pryor) is making life miserable for his daughter and new son-in-law..

videos.title: Unmarked Grave
videos.overview: A young outlaw uses an old woman as a pawn in his bid for freedom.

videos.title: Alarm at Pleasant Valley
videos.overview: While on the way back to Dodge, Matt and Chester discover a homsteading family fleeing Pleasant Valley, which is besieged by   Indians.

videos.title: Cow Doctor
videos.overview: After he is summoned unknowingly by Ben Pitcher to treat one of his cows, a human patient of Doc's dies. During a fight with Pitcher, Doc is knifed.

videos.title: Brush at Elkader
videos.overview: After his friend Ben Williams is shot down by Lou Shippen, Matt travels to Elkader to bring him him.  The only problem, he doesn't know what he looks like and the town is protecting Shippen.

videos.title: Custer
videos.overview: Matt refuses to turn the rustler Joe Trimble over to Major Banker for court-martial.

videos.title: The Round Up
videos.overview: Matt closes up shops to a group of drunken cowboys, which causes trouble.

videos.title: Young Man with a Gun
videos.overview: After gunman, Sam Kercher is killed by Matt, his 16-year-old brother arrives to fight Matt.

videos.title: Indian White
videos.overview: At Fort Dodge, home of the third cavalry, Mrs. Mary Cullen tells the colonel that the twelve year old white boy they recovered from the Cheyenne is her son Dennis. The tribe had taken him when he was two years old.

videos.title: How to Cure a Friend
videos.overview: Matt is used by an old friend in a con game.

videos.title: Legal Revenge
videos.overview: Doc comes upon a homesteader with a busted leg—and a gun to protect himself from his wife.

videos.title: The Mistake
videos.overview: Matt leaves Dodge City unprotected when he sets out to find a killer (Mike Connors) (Bert Rumsey credited as 'Bartender', but referred to by Chester as 'Sam Noonan').

videos.title: Greater Love
videos.overview: An outlaw threatens to kill Doc if he does not help his wounded buddy.

videos.title: No Indians
videos.overview: Matt and Chester act as decoys to ambush outlaws (including Mickey Simpson) that are masking their crimes as those of renegade Indians (Fintan Meyler and Herbert Rudley appear).

videos.title: Spring Term
videos.overview: Matt discovers that he was the intended victim of a murder he is investigating.

videos.title: Poor Pearl
videos.overview: Matt helps a woman whose suitors are about to duel for her affections.

videos.title: Cholera
videos.overview: A landowner (Paul Fix) tries to terrorize homesteaders (Bartlett Robinson and Peg Hillias) off their land (Gordon Gebert, John Smith, and Stuart Whitman appear).

videos.title: Pucket's New Year
videos.overview: An old buffalo hunter (Edgar Stehli) swears revenge on the skinner (Grant Withers) that left him to die (Richard Deacon appears as banker Botkin, Bert Rumsey credited as 'Bartender').

videos.title: The Cover Up
videos.overview: Matt traps a cattleman (Tyler McVey) who shot two homesteaders (including Roy Engel) (Malcolm Atterbury and Vivi Janiss appear).

videos.title: Sins of the Father
videos.overview: An Indian woman (Angie Dickinson) faces prejudice for her father's raid on Dodge City (Peter Whitney and Paul Wexler appear).

videos.title: Kick Me
videos.overview: A bank robber (Robert H. Harris) murders his wife and frames Tobeel (Frank de Kova) for the crime (Paul Lambert appears).

videos.title: Executioner
videos.overview: A young gunfighter, Tom Clegg, forces farmer Abe Curry into a duel and kills him. Matt can't arrest Clegg since Abe drew first. However, Abe's brother Morgan plots revenge.

videos.title: Gone Straight
videos.overview: Townspeople protect an outlaw (Carl Betz) they believe has reformed (Tige Andrews, Joe De Santis, John Dierkes, Marianne Stewart, and Ward Wood appear).

videos.title: Bloody Hands
videos.overview: The shooting of several members of an outlaw gang, though in self defense, triggers an emotional crisis in Matt, haunted by memories of all the men he has killed (Lawrence Dobkin, Russell Johnson, and Gloria Marshall appear).

videos.title: Skid Row
videos.overview: An Eastern girl makes the long trip to Dodge, only to find that her fiancé has lost his money and won't marry her.

videos.title: Sweet and Sour
videos.overview: Rena Decker, a new dance hall girl, purposely gets her admirers into fighting over her. Despite Kitty's negative opinion of her, Matt befreinds Rena and gets her a job at the Long Branch. Soon afterward, 4 men are dead and Rena is the cause.

videos.title: Cain
videos.overview: Ex-gunslinger Joel Adams' past is about to catch up with him.

videos.title: Bureaucrat
videos.overview: A Washington official is determined to tame Dodge City.

videos.title: Last Fling
videos.overview: Kitty gets annoyed by a pair of old farmers who are each trying to have a fling with her.

videos.title: Chester's Murder
videos.overview: Chester is drinking at the Long Branch and gets into an argument with a gambler over a girl. When the marshal breaks it up, he tells Chester to bring the man to jail. On the way there, the man is killed and everyone thinks Chester did it.

videos.title: The Photographer
videos.overview: Dodge City meets a Photographer who shows the residents how a camera works.  Jacoby wants to take pictures of how the Wild West looks. When Matt learns someone died, he thinks the photographer may have hired someone to kill Grubby for a picture of the west.

videos.title: Wrong Man
videos.overview: A cowboy vows revenge for the shooting of his friend, who was mistaken for a criminal (Don Keefer and Catherine McLeod, real-life husband and wife, appear as a husband and wife).

videos.title: Big Girl Lost
videos.overview: Philip Locke is looking for Laura Simmons, a saloon girl, but she doesn't want him to know where she works. Laura tells Matt that she and Philip were previously engaged, and she asks him not to say anything about her job. Philip warns Matt that he will be killed if he doesn't tell the truth.

videos.title: What the Whiskey Drummer Heard
videos.overview: Matt fakes his death to lure a gunman (Vic Perrin) out in the open (Robert Karnes appears, Bert Rumsey credited as 'Sam').

videos.title: Cheap Labor
videos.overview: A former gunfighter has turned away from violence, but his fiancee's brother is determined to goad him into a gunfight.

videos.title: Moon
videos.overview: After Charlie Brewer is found dead, Jack Salter who was a friend of Charlie Brewer comes to Matt's office saying Vint killed Brewer. Matt then tries to find out if Jack is right.

videos.title: Who Lives by the Sword
videos.overview: Joe Delk causes trouble at The Long Branch after shooting two men who were unarmed.

videos.title: Uncle Oliver
videos.overview: Matt goes after an outlaw (Earle Hodgins) who shot Chester (Paul Wexler appears).

videos.title: Daddy-O
videos.overview: Kitty's father, Wayne Russell, arrives in Dodge to meet his daughter after abandoning her and her mother as a baby.  He insists that saloon life is not fit for a proper lady and wants to take her back to New Orleans so he can pamper her and invest her savings in his freight business.

videos.title: The Man Who Would Be Marshal
videos.overview: A former Army Officer wants Matt Dillon's job. Matt then takes Mr. Egan on his rounds.   Matt lets Egan try his brand of justice that almost costs Egan his life.

videos.title: Liar from Blackhawk
videos.overview: A braggart tries to provoke a gunfight with a harmless drunk.

videos.title: Jealousy
videos.overview: Jack Kelly plays a hot-tempered husband who thinks Matt is after his wife.

videos.title: Crack-Up
videos.overview: Matt learns there is a hired killer in Dodge City, the hired killer gives Matt a challenge to find out who paid Nate Springer to kill Matt.

videos.title: Gun for Chester
videos.overview: Chester believes Asa Ledbetter is out to kill him. After Chester is shot, he tells Matt Asa Ledbetter shot him. Matt worries that Chester may be working too hard on finding Asa Ledbetter. Asa Ledbetter claims Chester killed his brother.

videos.title: Blood Money
videos.overview: After Harry Spencer's life is saved Matt receives a wanted poster for Joe Sharpe who robbed a bank. Matt learns that Joe and Shape left Dodge so Sharpe could try and get the reward money.

videos.title: Kitty's Outlaw
videos.overview: Doc, Chester, and Matt suspect Kitty of helping a bank robber when she invites Matt to an out of the way spot for dinner.  What they didn't know was that the bank robber was the first 'man' Kitty had ever known.

videos.title: Potato Road
videos.overview: Budge wants the Marshall to arrest his Pa for murder but when they get to Budge's house they get captured by Bud & his Ma so they can rob the bank.

videos.title: Jesse
videos.overview: Jesse comes to Dodge to kill the man who killed his Pa.

videos.title: Mavis McCloud
videos.overview: Mavis McCloud comes to Dodge to get married. She marries Barny but Lou Staley comes looking for Mavis and wants to kill Barney and the Marshall.

videos.title: Born to Hang
videos.overview: Joe Digger wants to kill the two men who tried to lynch him.

videos.title: Romeo
videos.overview: A powerful landowner threatens to wipe out Dodge when his daughter falls in love with the son of his archenemy. Matt has to find a way to stop it.

videos.title: Never Pester Chester
videos.overview: When Matt sends Chester out to handle a rowdy couple of cow pokers, Chester ends up nearly dead.  Matt is so guilt ridden he vows to find the men who did it and make them pay.

videos.title: Fingered
videos.overview: The people of Dodge gets suspicious of Jim Cobbett (John Larch) when his second wife (Virginia Christine) vanishes just like his first (Karl Swenson appears).

videos.title: How to Kill a Woman
videos.overview: Pernell Roberts appears in this episode, as Matt tries to find a killer who robbed the stagecoach.

videos.title: Cows and Cribs
videos.overview: The whole town is caught up in a mystery: where does Joe Nadler get all his money---and where does he go to spend it?

videos.title: Doc's Reward
videos.overview: Doc kills a man who shoots his horse. The man's brother comes looking for Doc because he thinks Doc killed his brother for reward money.

videos.title: Kitty Lost
videos.overview: An eastern dude asks Kitty if she'd like to take a midnight drive, but when she doesn't return the next day, Matt goes looking.

videos.title: Twelfth Night
videos.overview: A hillbilly arrives in Dodge looking to continue a feud started back in the hills of Virginia.

videos.title: Joe Phy
videos.overview: Matt goes to Elkader after the man who shot him and runs into Joe Phy "US Marshall".

videos.title: Buffalo Man
videos.overview: Matt & Chester are taken prisoner by two buffalo hunters who are hunting buffalo in Indian territory. The hunters leave them tied to a wagon in hopes that the Indians will kill them.

videos.title: Kitty Caught
videos.overview: The Gunner brothers rob the bank in Dodge and take Kitty hostage.

videos.title: Claustrophobia
videos.overview:
Ollie Ridgers is a free spirited man who hates towns and lives free on the prairie. His friend Jim Branch convinces Ollie to go into Dodge for a good time at Miss Kitty's saloon.

While Ollie is in town, two men kill Ollie's hogs and mule. Ollie goes after the two men thus killing one of the men.

Matt is forced to arrest his good friend Ollie for killing one of the men.

After Ollie has been found guilty of murder and sentenced to a long prison term, Ollie's friend,  (Jim Branch) kills Ollie to spare Ollie from the cruelty of being being incarcerated for the rest of his life.

videos.title: Ma Tennis
videos.overview: Andy Tennis kills a gambler. Matt arrests him but Andy's mother breaks him out of jail.

videos.title: Sunday Supplement
videos.overview: Clifton Bunker and Samuel Spring, writers from New York, come to Dodge looking for a story. Finding none they stir up trouble to get a story.

videos.title: Wild West
videos.overview: Hattie throws in with two men to kill her husband and then sell his ranch for the money. Yorky Kelley sees the men ride off with his father and trails them till his horse breaks a leg. On the prarie Yorky finds Marshall Dillon and asks for his help finding his Pa.

videos.title: The Cabin
videos.overview: Matt get caught in a blizzard then finds shelter in a cabin but finds more than he bargained for.

videos.title: Dirt
videos.overview:
Nat Seiber and Polly Troyman are to be married.

When Polly's younger Brother finds out that Nat had visited another woman (Beulah)late one evening at her house, Polly's  Brother (Henry Troyman) thinks that Nat has dishonored his Sister Polly and promises to stop the wedding anyway he can.

When Nat is shot on his wedding day, everyone thinks Polly's Brother  committed the shooting.

After Matt and Chester do an investigation, Matt comes to another conclusion about the shooting of Nat Seiber.

videos.title: Dooley Surrenders
videos.overview: Hide skinner Emmett Dooley thinks he killed a man while drunk and turns himself in.

videos.title: Joke's on Us
videos.overview: Jake Kaiser and some other ranchers hung Frank Tillman thinking he was a horse thief but they were wrong. Tillman's wife and son won't tell the Marshall who did it.

videos.title: Bottleman
videos.overview: Tom Cassidy (a drunk) tries to kill Dan Clell (a new gambler) in town.

videos.title: Laughing Gas
videos.overview: Ernie Stubblefield trying to put his past behind him changes his name to Earl Stafford and is traveling with a laughing gas show. Cloud Marsh tries the gas and gets laughed at by the town. Angry he and his brothers attack Stubblefield/Stafford.

videos.title: Texas Cowboys
videos.overview: The friends of a murdered Texan decide to take the law into their own hands.

videos.title: Amy's Good Deed
videos.overview: Amy Slatter comes to Dodge to try and get Matt to kill her because in the Dakota territory Matt had to kill her brother.

videos.title: Hanging Man
videos.overview: Someone keeps hanging people in Dodge and making it look like suicide.

videos.title: Innocent Broad
videos.overview: A woman's boyfriend causes trouble for Matt with his constant fits of jealousy.

videos.title: The Big Con
videos.overview: Mr. Shaneway wants Mr. Pap at the bank to loan him $20,000 for a poker bet. When the con begins to unfold, Doc gets kidnapped.

videos.title: Widow's Mite
videos.overview: Gambler Leach Fields marries Zach Morton's widow Ada thinking she knows where the money Zach stole is.

videos.title: Chester's Hanging
videos.overview: Matt arrests James Cando. Cando tells Lee Binders to break him out. In the attempt to get him out Cando tries to hang Chester.

videos.title: Carmen
videos.overview: A secret Army payroll is stolen and two soldiers killed. The Major threatens Matt with martial law if the thieves aren't caught. Matt suspects Jenny Lane, a new girl at the Long Branch of being involved.

videos.title: Overland Express
videos.overview: Matt and Chester track Nation for a killing in Dodge. Nation kills their horses then gives himself up. They wind up having to take a stage back to Dodge. Nation recognizes a man on the stage and helps Matt prevent a robbery.

videos.title: The Gentleman
videos.overview: Marcus France, a "Gentleman Gambler" comes to Dodge and falls in love with Bonnie Damon. Tiller Evans thinks Bonnie is his girl. Matt has to keep Tiller from killing France.

videos.title: Matt for Murder
videos.overview: Matt resigns as Marshall after Tom Samples accuses Matt of killing an innocent man;however, Doc and Matt's old friend Wild Bill Hickok come up with a plan that might clear Matt of this erroneous charge of murder.

videos.title: The Patsy
videos.overview: Matt doubts the veracity of Long Branch hostess Holly Fanshaw's claim that she saw trail drover Fly Hoyt murder young Dave Thorp. His suspicions increase further when Hoyt voluntarily returns to Dodge in order to clear his name.

videos.title: Gunsmuggler
videos.overview: Matt believes white smugglers supplied the guns that a band of Pawnee used to attack local ranchers.

videos.title: Monopoly
videos.overview: Two murders result when an unscrupulous Eastern businessman named Ivy hires a psychotic killer to help him establish undisputed control of Dodge City's freight shipment business.

videos.title: Letter of the Law
videos.overview: A rich landowner seizes the chance to get a little more acreage when he discovers that a homesteader has failed to file the paperwork to make his quarter section his own.

videos.title: Thoroughbreds
videos.overview: Matt and Chester, out of water while riding back to Dodge, come upon a man with two fine horses who is not very trusting. When they meet him later in Dodge, he is much different: friendly and spending money freely.

videos.title: Stage Hold-Up
videos.overview: A stagecoach on which Matt and Chester are riding is robbed and another passenger is murdered. Matt utilizes a ruse to incriminate the thieves when a "cowboy" appears and offers to show him where one of the thieves may be buried.

videos.title: Lost Rifle
videos.overview: Matt refuses to arrest his friend Ben Tiple without more evidence, when the man he has been feuding with is found shot in the back.

videos.title: Land Deal
videos.overview: When a stranger leading some immigrants planning on settling outside of Dodge wants Matt to give him a badge to avert trouble, Matt gets suspicious and rides out to their camp to see what is really up.

videos.title: Lynching Man
videos.overview: After mild-mannered Hank Blenis is "lynched" by the two men who stole his horse, self-righteous Charlie Drain decides to take the law into his own hands and is led tragically astray by the culprits.

videos.title: How to Kill a Friend
videos.overview: Two gamblers find Matt incorruptible and attempt to intimidate him by hiring gunman Toque Morlan. The two are ironically unaware that Morlan was Matt's close friend until a long-ago attack by a mob left Morlan scarred and harboring a bitter grudge against lawmen.

videos.title: Grass
videos.overview: White men pretending to be Indians attack greenhorn Harry Pope at night, and he kills one of them. Now the dead man's friends want revenge.

videos.title: The Cast
videos.overview: When Doc arrives too late to save his patient, her husband, a good friend of Matt's, blames Doc for her death.

videos.title: Robber Bridegroom
videos.overview: Financially desperate Jack Fitch robs a stagecoach and abducts passenger Laura Church, unaware that she is "engaged" to an unscrupulous businessman who threatened to ruin her father if he did not agree to the marriage.

videos.title: Snakebite
videos.overview: Claustrophobic plainsman Poney Thompson is arrested for murdering a man who maliciously shot his dog, but an ironic fate awaits him after he breaks free from Chester's custody.

videos.title: Gypsum Hills Feud
videos.overview: Matt's attempt to find a man who shot at him from ambush leads him and Chester into the middle of a murderous feud between two bitter and isolated mountain families.

videos.title: Young Love
videos.overview: Over the objections of his sometime partner Rod Allison, treacherous Jim Box murders aging rancher Jesse Wheat, then attempts to steal cattle from Wheat's young widow.

videos.title: Marshal Proudfoot
videos.overview: Matt goes along with a hoax when Chester's aging Uncle Wesley arrives for a visit.  Wesley thinks Chester is the marshal and Dillion is his assistant.

videos.title: Passive Resistance
videos.overview: A man's house is burned and his livestock killed, but he refuses to identify the perpetrators to the marshal.

videos.title: Love of a Good Woman
videos.overview: An old friend of Doc's, a nurse, is visiting and he hopes she will stay around Dodge. In the meantime Matt is worried that an ex-con is gunning for him even though he thought he was innocent five years ago.

videos.title: Jayhawkers
videos.overview: Trail boss Dolph Quince sends for his friend Matt to help escort his cattle herd into Dodge because he is having trouble with Jayhawkers (Kansas renegades), and he hopes to ease the animosity his men have towards all Kansans.

videos.title: Kitty's Rebellion
videos.overview: An old friend of the family comes to Dodge looking for Kitty, but when he finds out she's a saloon owner, he's dismayed.  Intent on defending her honor wherever she is insulted, he nearly gets himself killed.  Kitty finally tells him that she has no honor, and he keeps making a fool out of himself thinking otherwise.  It sends him away and saves his life at the same time.

videos.title: Sky
videos.overview: Young Billy flees Dodge in fear after being suspected of shooting dead an older saloon girl whose sexual advances he had been resisting.

videos.title: Doc Quits
videos.overview: Doc takes hard the death of a homesteader under his care; then a flashy new medicine man comes to town and takes away many of his patients.

videos.title: The Bear
videos.overview: Rivalry for the affections of a former saloon gal leads to a frame-up for murder.

videos.title: The Coward
videos.overview: A coward gambler, who's too cheap to hire a gunman, wants Matt dead for a beating he got from him years ago, so he starts some talk around Dodge about the big reputation any person could gain, if they simply killed Matt.

videos.title: The F.U.
videos.overview:
When Onie Becker is shot down on the streets of Dodge after quarreling with Al Clovis in a poker game, everyone thinks Al Clovis committed the shooting.

The plot thickens after Matt and Chester pursue Clovis on a train headed out of Dodge.

videos.title: Wind
videos.overview: Men start killing each other over saloon girl Dolly Varden, who seems to bring gamblers luck just by standing next to them when they're playing cards.

videos.title: Fawn
videos.overview: After years of captivity, a white woman and her half-Indian daughter are set free by the Indians, but they are shunned in Dodge.

videos.title: Renegade White
videos.overview: A gunfight in the Long Branch forces Matt to arrest a drunk. Letting him go since it was a fair fight, he suspects him of selling guns to the Indians, and goes after him even though he may run into those Indians.

videos.title: Murder Warrant
videos.overview: Matt and Dodge City's businessmen employ an unusual tactic to save ambush victim Lee Prentice from being taken to corrupt Baker City to face certain hanging on a trumped-up murder charge.

videos.title: Change of Heart
videos.overview: Matt becomes suspicious when Jerry Cass's plans to marry saloon hostess Bella Grant are complicated by Bella's sudden insistence that Jerry leave his recently-inherited ranch for six months.

videos.title: Buffalo Hunter
videos.overview: Marshal Dillon has to stop a ruthless, cold-blooded, greedy, buffalo hunter who is in the habit of brutally killing his hired help to avoid paying them their wages.

videos.title: The Choice
videos.overview: Matt tries to help Andy Hill, a young gunman who is apparently trying very hard to go straight, by getting him a job riding shotgun on the stagecoach.

videos.title: There Was Never a Horse
videos.overview: Gunman Kin Creed arrives in Dodge determined to enhance his reputation by outdrawing Matt in a gunfight. He goes to great lengths to force Matt into a confrontation and is able to wound him, but it proves to be a pyrrhic victory.

videos.title: Print Asper
videos.overview: Print Asper is suspected of attempted murder when he forces a crooked lawyer, at gunpoint, to return the ranch he stole from him, and the lawyer still ends up getting shot later by someone.

videos.title: The Constable
videos.overview: Dodge City's businessmen learn a hard lesson when they reject Matt's advice and hire a meek constable to handle a gang of rowdy but free-spending trail cowboys.

videos.title: Blue Horse
videos.overview: Seriously injured Matt faces a moral dilemma when Blue Horse saves his life and prevents the escape of a prisoner. The Marshal knows that Blue Horse is being sought by the Cavalry as a fugitive from a reservation, and he is well aware that he is duty-bound to assist their search in any way possible.

videos.title: Cheyennes
videos.overview: Matt seeks the help of wise Chief Long Robe to track down gunrunners who are supplying renegade Cheyenne braves with rifles used to murder prairie-dwelling families. Long Robe provides Matt with the needed information, but warns him that the death of even a single brave could lead to a violent uprising.

videos.title: Target
videos.overview: Ironic tragedy results when Danny Kader stubbornly disregards his father's predispositions (and Matt's pragmatic advice) in order to attempt an elopement with a young gypsy woman.

videos.title: Kitty's Injury
videos.overview: When Kitty is hurt in a fall from a horse, she and Matt must seek help from shiftless dirt farmers who are oddly uninterested in aiding them.

videos.title: Horse Deal
videos.overview: Horses with Bar S brand are being sold to unsuspecting buyers. Deesha moves in to claim the horses, leaving the buyer with nothing.

videos.title: Johnny Red
videos.overview: A man suddenly turns up in Dodge City claiming to be Billy Crale, the long-lost son of a well-to-do local widow. Matt knows that Billy Crale was reported dead during the Civil War, and he becomes highly concerned for Mrs. Crale's safety when he confirms that the man is actually a onetime outlaw known as Johnny Red.

videos.title: Tail to the Wind
videos.overview: A father and son bully a farmer and his wife who won't sell their land, but the farmer is oddly reluctant to let Matt arrest the two, even when they resort to gunfire.

videos.title: Annie Oakley
videos.overview: Is the homely, sharp-tongued, middle-aged wife of a homesteader really inspiring men to fight to the death for her affections?

videos.title: Kangaroo
videos.overview: Chester saves a man from a zealot's violent "justice" then faces a dose of the same himself.

videos.title: Saludos
videos.overview: Matt, escorting 3 men back to Dodge, claims a beautiful wounded Indian woman will be able to identify the one who shot her and killed her husband.

videos.title: Brother Whelp
videos.overview: A man wants to gunfight when he returns home, after years away, and finding his brother married to his girl.

videos.title: The Boots
videos.overview: Onetime gunman Zeno Smith faces an unenviable choice. If he does not help would-be gambler Hank Fergus rob Mr. Jonas's general store, Fergus will tell 12-year old orphan Tommy the full story of how Zeno's descent into deprivation and alcoholism dates to the day he backed down from facing Fergus in a gunfight.

videos.title: Odd Man Out
videos.overview: Matt is uncertain what to make of Cyrus Tucker's confused claim that his wife of 32 years "just ran off", especially when a homesteader claims that he saw the old man digging a large hole just behind his house.

videos.title: Miguel's Daughter
videos.overview: A father threatens to kill the two drifters who have been plaguing his daughter.

videos.title: Box o' Rocks
videos.overview: A man enlists the aid of a parson to fake his own death.

videos.title: False Witness
videos.overview: A man is convicted of murder on doubtful testimony.

videos.title: Tag, You're It
videos.overview: When hired gunman Killion comes to Dodge, many of the men get scared thinking he is after them.

videos.title: Thick 'n' Thin
videos.overview: A quarrel between two partners in homesteading escalates to the point of gunfire. Matt tries to make peace between them by locking them up together.

videos.title: Groat's Grudge
videos.overview: An ex-Confederate waits to settle the score with the Union man whose unit cost him a loved one and property in the late war.

videos.title: Big Tom
videos.overview: Despite a serious heart condition, onetime prizefighter Tom Burr is determined to go through with his plans to fight vicious Hob Creel. The only way Matt can stop the mismatch and save Burr's life is to fight Creel himself.

videos.title: Till Death Do Us
videos.overview: Someone takes a shot at a hard man who is brutal to his wife, and someone is overheard claiming he was offered money to kill the man.

videos.title: The Tragedian
videos.overview: Matt and his friends try to come to the aid of a has-been actor caught cheating at cards.

videos.title: Hinka Do
videos.overview: Matt has reason to believe that the new overweight, gun toting, straight shooting, female owner of the Lady Gay saloon may have killed the previous owner, or did she?

videos.title: Doc Judge
videos.overview: While Matt is away on business, Doc gets threatened by an ex convict (Brice Harp) who claims that Doc Adams sentenced him to a long term in Prison.

videos.title: Moo Moo Raid
videos.overview: Old man Onie has a great swimming cow that can lead herds across rivers, and when they both come up missing, one trail boss accuses another of killing them.

videos.title: Kitty's Killing
videos.overview: Kitty gets caught in the middle when a crazy-eyed man goes hunting for his former son-in-law, whom he blames for the death of his daughter in childbirth.

videos.title: Jailbait Janet
videos.overview: After a train sparks a fire that destroys a family's crops, the man, his son, and his daughter rob another train of fifty thousand dollars. A baggage clerk is killed and the crusty representative of the railroad pressures Matt to solve it.

videos.title: Unwanted Deputy
videos.overview: Determined to avenge his murderous brother's hanging, Vince Walsh begins a self-serving campaign of unofficially helping to keep the peace in Dodge City over Matt's objections. Walsh is certain that his actions and his taunts will eventually goad the Marshal into a gunfight.

videos.title: Where'd They Go
videos.overview: When Jonas accuses Clint Dodie of robbing his store, Matt and Chester set out in the bitter cold go to Clint's farm to make an arrest.

videos.title: Crowbait Bob
videos.overview: When the greedy relatives of a dying man (Crowbait Bob) learn that he might be dying, they come to Dodge to grab anything of value they can get from the dying man.

videos.title: Colleen So Green
videos.overview: A southern belle charms Chester and many others in Dodge, but Kitty isn't falling for her charms.

videos.title: The Ex-Urbanites
videos.overview: Far from Dodge, Chester finds himself in the uncomfortable position of trying to extract a bullet in order to save Doc's life after the two are ambushed by a pair of savage prairie wolfers.

videos.title: I Thee Wed
videos.overview: A man beats his wife and is sentenced to fifty days or fifty dollars by the judge. The beaten woman scrapes together the money for her husband's fine, only to be beaten again.

videos.title: The Lady Killer
videos.overview: A saloon girl shoots a man who came to her room, claiming he attacked her, but as the dead man was to testify against a man from the woman's past, Matt is suspicious.

videos.title: Gentleman's Disagreement
videos.overview: Ed makes no secret of his intention to kill Bert for marrying the girl Ed wanted. So when Ed is the one who turns up dead, folks assume that Bert did it.

videos.title: Speak Me Fair
videos.overview: There's a cattle drive near town, and the cowboys are nervous about a series of cattle rustling events that have taken place recently.

videos.title: Belle's Back
videos.overview: Belle Ainesly rides into town after 3 years absence. Seems she ran off with an unsavory character 3 years ago, and all of Dodge feels she's a "bad" woman. Belle says she is coming back to stay at the family ranch.

videos.title: The Bobsy Twins
videos.overview: Two brothers have decided that it is their mission to rid the West of Indians.

videos.title: Old Flame
videos.overview: Kitty doubts the veracity of Matt's old friend Dolly Winters, who arrives in Dodge seeking the Marshal's help and claiming to have been robbed, beaten, and jilted by a man named Rad Meadows.

videos.title: The Deserter
videos.overview: Matt is on the trail of a badly wounded corporal for robbing the army payroll and falls into a trap when the father of the corporal gets the drop on him and wounds Chester.

videos.title: Cherry Red
videos.overview: The widow of a stagecoach robber is courted by the man who, unbeknownst to the widow, is the one who shot her husband.

videos.title: Friend's Pay-Off
videos.overview: Matt is summoned to help an old friend, Ab Butler, who has been shot in the back and left for dead.  However, Matt faces a difficult situation when Ab's partner shows up and tells his side of the story.

videos.title: The Blacksmith
videos.overview: Troublemakers trick an immigrant blacksmith into leaving his house on his wedding night, then burn it down.

videos.title: Small Water
videos.overview: Matt arrests Finn Pickett after recognizing his face from a wanted poster.  On the way back to Dodge, Pickett's vengeful sons try to free their father as Matt and Chester face a water shortage.

videos.title: Say Uncle
videos.overview: Lee Nagel suspects his visiting uncle of murder when his father is killed in their store in an apparent accident.

videos.title: Shooting Stopover
videos.overview: While transporting a prisoner with Chester on a stagecoach to Wichita, Matt learns that the stagecoach is also carrying a shipment of gold, and he suspects the coach might be targeted by outlaws.

videos.title: The Peace Officer
videos.overview: Matt is called in to deal with a corrupt sheriff in Tascosa.

videos.title: Don Matteo
videos.overview: Matt's old friend, Esteban Garcia, tracks a man into Dodge and plans to kill him for stealing his wife.

videos.title: The Worm
videos.overview: Murders follow when a buffalo hunter and his browbeaten partner come to town.

videos.title: The Badge
videos.overview: Out on the prairie, Matt is shot and taken captive by two outlaws, one of whom is a weakling abused and bossed around by the other.

videos.title: Distant Drummer
videos.overview: A young army drummer named Raffie is terrorized by two bullying mule skinners.

videos.title: Ben Tolliver's Stud
videos.overview: Jake Creed accuses his young hired hand, Ben Tolliver, of horse theft.

videos.title: No Chip
videos.overview: The vicious Dolan brothers move in on a tough cattle rancher and his non-violent son.

videos.title: The Wake
videos.overview: Gus Mather arrives in Dodge in a wagon, carrying the coffin of his best friend, Orson Boggs, to give him a proper wake. There's only one problem:  according to Mrs. Boggs, her late husband didn't have any friends.

videos.title: The Cook
videos.overview: A young drifter takes a job as cook at Delmonico's but accidentally kills a crazy buffalo hunter who complains about his cooking.

videos.title: Old Fool
videos.overview: A scheming woman (Else Hedgepath), who is after the money and wealth of Hannibal Bass, makes a play for Hannibal, but runs into some serious, SERIOUS  trouble though when she tangles with *MRS* Bass!

videos.title: Brother Love
videos.overview: In a family that believes in taking care of its own--including administering punishment within the family for crime--one of two grown brothers appears to have committed murder, but which one?

videos.title: Bad Sheriff
videos.overview: A man shoots his partner, flees, and is caught by two men claiming to be lawmen.

videos.title: Unloaded Gun
videos.overview: Red and Joe Lime are no-good murderous brothers, and Matt has to track 'em down out on the prairie. Trouble is, Matt comes down with a fever due to missing out on so much sleep in the last couple of weeks. This situation causes some serious problems for all involved when Matt has to return to Dodge because he is too sick to pursue the Lime brothers.

videos.title: Tall Trapper
videos.overview: A man and his wife come across a lone trapper and make camp with him. Next day, the husband comes to Dodge to report to Doc that his wife is sick, but Doc finds the woman beaten to death, and the husband accuses the trapper.

videos.title: Love Thy Neighbor
videos.overview: The theft of a sack of potatoes leads to increasingly violent hostilities between the Scooper and Galloway families.

videos.title: Bad Seed
videos.overview: Matt rescues teen-aged Trudy Trent from a life of isolated poverty with her incestuous and alcoholic father, but he subsequently learns that "Hell hath no fury like a woman scorned" when he rejects her misguided romantic overtures toward him.

videos.title: Kitty Shot
videos.overview: Dillon goes after cowboy Jake Bayloe after he guns down his partner in the Long Branch , shooting Kitty in the crossfire and critically wounding her.

videos.title: About Chester
videos.overview: While Chester is out searching for Doc, his horse is injured. Chester goes to a house for help and is instead taken prisoner.

videos.title: Harriet
videos.overview: After witnessing the callous murder of her kindly father, Harriet Horne disregards Matt's advice and unwisely attempts to extract revenge from the perpetrators by making them jealous rivals for her attention.

videos.title: Potshot
videos.overview: A concealed gunman takes a shot at Chester, and it may have been a bank robber, or it may have been someone who's been making trouble at the Long Branch.

videos.title: Old Faces
videos.overview: Hot-headed Tom's new wife used to be a river-boat girl, and when a gunman from her old life recognizes her, a battle between the two men is brewing.

videos.title: Big Man
videos.overview: To protect Kitty, Matt is forced to physically (and publicly) subdue fractious troublemaker Pat Swarner. When Swarner is subsequently found murdered, oft-inebriated Jud Sloan's claim that the Marshal was the killer seems uncomfortably credible.

videos.title: Little Girl
videos.overview: Marshal Dillon must find a suitable home for Charity Gill, a young orphan, after the little girl's father dies when his cabin catches fire. Charity insists that she should live with the Dodge City lawman.

videos.title: Stolen Horses
videos.overview: A horse thief murders a man to get his horses. Matt tracks the criminal to a Kiowa camp.

videos.title: Minnie
videos.overview: Rough and rowdy Minnie comes to Dodge City and sets her designs on Doc Adams, much to the delight of Matt, Chester and Kitty. Trouble comes though when  Minnie's husband  comes to Dodge and finds out that his Minnie is sweet on Doc.

videos.title: Bless Me Till I Die
videos.overview: Vengeful former convict Nate Bush sets off a tragic series of events when he informs Matt that well-liked new arrival Cole Treadwell is actually Cole Trankin, an escapee from the Arizona Territorial Prison.

videos.title: Long Hours, Short Pay
videos.overview: A gunrunner supplies the Pawnee with weapons. Matt arrests him, but when the Pawnee find out, they capture Matt and free his prisoner.

videos.title: Hard Virtue
videos.overview: Hot tempered Andy Coe and his wife want to sell their wagon to Moss, but can't when Ed Fallon's team spooks and crashes into their wagon.

videos.title: The Imposter
videos.overview: A man claiming to be a sheriff from Texas comes to Dodge and asks Matt for help tracking down a named fugitive, but the man may not be a lawman.

videos.title: Chester's Dilemma
videos.overview: A pretty girl arrives in town and chases Chester, who's happy for her to do so, but the young woman has a secret that may land her in jail.

videos.title: The Love of Money
videos.overview: When an ex-marshal passing through town is shot in the back, Matt suspects a new saloon gal might have had something to do with it.

videos.title: Melinda Miles
videos.overview: When Roy Tayloe is murdered following a poker game, quick-tempered Harry Miles is certain that daughter Melinda's suitor Tom Potter is the killer. Miles quickly becomes impatient with Matt's methodical investigation of the crime and threatens to kill Potter himself unless he stays away from Melinda.

videos.title: Colorado Sheriff
videos.overview: Matt and Chester find Rod Ellison shot and paralyzed on the prairie and return him to Dodge for surgery. Ben Witter abrasively advises Matt that he is a deputy sheriff from Pueblo who has come to Dodge to arrest Ellison for robbery, but Matt is suspicious of Witter's refusal to produce a valid arrest warrant.

videos.title: Perce
videos.overview: Ex-con Perce McCall helps to save Matt's life in a shootout, and then falls for a beautiful, but greedy saloon girl who puts him under great pressure to start stealing again.

videos.title: Old Yellow Boots
videos.overview: Matt becomes suspicious when drifter Frank Cassidy publicly announces his engagement to spinsterish Beulah Parker immediately after the seemingly unrelated murders of an old prospector and her abusive brother Leroy.

videos.title: Miss Kitty
videos.overview: Kitty has her friends in Dodge buzzing when she meets the stage in the early hours to pick up a small boy. All wonder, especially his foster parents: could his real mother be Kitty?

videos.title: Harper's Blood
videos.overview: A hard man has given his two sons a hard raising, sure that they inherited their mother's bad blood from their murderous ancestor. The old man may be right: one of his sons may be a murderer. Or is it the other son?

videos.title: All That
videos.overview: A man who lost his wife and all he had returns to Dodge from gold prospecting with three bulging bags to deposit in the bank, and all who scorned him before, including his ex-wife, can't do enough for him.

videos.title: Long, Long Trail
videos.overview: A headstrong young woman will undertake the long, dangerous journey to her fiancé's fort on her own if she must, so Matt nominates himself to escort her.

videos.title: The Squaw
videos.overview: His mother has been dead almost a year, and Cully is troubled by his pa's carousing. When they discuss his getting married again, it seems like a good idea until he returns from a business trip with a new wife, an Arapaho squaw, who he has conflicted emotions about.

videos.title: Chesterland
videos.overview: Chester becomes engaged more or less accidentally, but he takes to heart his obligation to his betrothed, leaving his job with Mr. Dillon to devote himself to homesteading a barren quarter section.

videos.title: Milly
videos.overview: The plain but nubile daughter of a hopeless drunkard decides to marry herself off so that she and her little brother might avoid starvation.

videos.title: Indian Ford
videos.overview: Matt escorts a captain and his troops to an Indian village, to make an exchange for a white woman captured over a year ago.

videos.title: Apprentice Doc
videos.overview: A young outlaw finds he has a knack for medicine and turns straight, telling Doc he wants to be his pupil.

videos.title: Nina's Revenge
videos.overview: A homesteader hires a man to make the appearance of a scandal with his wife so that he can blackmail his wife's wealthy father.

videos.title: Marry Me
videos.overview: Orkey Cathcart is looking for a wife and sets his sites on Miss Kitty.

videos.title: A Man a Day
videos.overview: Outlaws want Matt to leave Dodge so they can steal from the bank or they will kill a man per day.

videos.title: The Do-Badder
videos.overview: Prospector Harvey Easter settles in Dodge City after striking it rich in the Colorado Rockies. His heavy handed attempts at philanthropy soon have unintended results.

videos.title: Lacey
videos.overview: A hired man is sweet on his boss's daughter and disliked by his boss. When the boss is killed, his own daughter claims to have done it, but Matt is suspicious.

videos.title: Cody's Code
videos.overview: Cody is a well-liked citizen of Dodge. He's building a house and getting married. When he befriends a stranger, his perfect life is turned upside down.

videos.title: Old Dan
videos.overview: Beginning with Doc, who rescues him from a ditch, everyone wants to give amiable drunk Dan a chance, or a job, or both.

videos.title: Catawomper
videos.overview: Chester is getting home-cooked meals from, and giving guitar lessons to, a spirited young woman who hopes thereby to make her estranged sweetheart jealous.

videos.title: Half Straight
videos.overview: A man has been hired to kill Matt, but when he meets and quickly falls in love with a decent girl, he has a change of heart--or does he?

videos.title: He Learned About Women
videos.overview: Taken prisoner by a band of comancheros, Chester is helped to escape by one of the band's women and flees with another who may or may not be worthy of his trust.

videos.title: The Gallows
videos.overview: While returning suspected killer Pruit Dover to Dodge to stand trial, Matt is shot and badly wounded, and yet Dover stays with him and nurses him back to health.

videos.title: Reprisal
videos.overview: Oren was a rancher who liked his drink, gambling and women, even though he had a pretty wife at home. Matt is forced to kill him and when he breaks the news to her, all she can see is getting revenge for his death, and Matt is her target.

videos.title: Coventry
videos.overview: A speculator in land is already unpopular in Dodge, but when he is acquitted of the murder of a man he killed, he finds himself "sent to Coventry": no one in town, not even Kitty, will buy, sell, or even speak to him.

videos.title: The Widow
videos.overview: A young woman comes to Dodge insisting on an escort to Indian country so that the body of her husband, believed to have been killed fighting the Kiowa, may be recovered.

videos.title: Durham Bull
videos.overview: Little Bit and his grandpa, from Texas, are passing through Dodge after buying a breeding bull. When they meet Silva, someone grandpa considers a "fooler", they have their hands full making it back with their stock and their lives.

videos.title: Wagon Girls
videos.overview: A group of women are going by wagon train to Colorado, lured by the promise of marrying rich miners, but Matt learns that the leader's actual plan for the women is quite different.

videos.title: The Dealer
videos.overview: Johnny Cole kills a crooked card dealer in self defense, and then falls in love with the dealer's beautiful daughter, but she resists his advances and wants to seriously hurt him instead.

videos.title: The Summons
videos.overview: Loy has always felt he could do what he pleased. When he shoots one of his gang members in the back just for the reward, he takes the body into Dodge to Matt Dillon who isn't as ready as he thought to give him his bounty.

videos.title: The Dreamers
videos.overview: Henry and Jake have struck it rich. Now they want to follow their dream and buy a Mississippi river boat. When Henry spots Miss Kitty, he fancies marrying her but she will have nothing to do with his dream or him.

videos.title: Cale
videos.overview: Cale is a bullheaded young drifter who takes a nap in a barn he comes across only to wake up to a shootout between a horse thief and the owner. Cale is shot, wounded, and becomes a suspected accomplice.

videos.title: Chester's Indian
videos.overview: On his way to a fishing vacation, Chester stumbles into a human drama when he wounds a fleeing Indian he mistakes for a thief, who has touched the heart of a lonely young white woman.

videos.title: The Prisoner
videos.overview: A charmer escapes from federal prison to Dodge and finds himself caught up in the drama among two brothers, the wife of one of them, and their domineering father.

videos.title: The Boys
videos.overview: The market for snake oil is on the decline, so a peddler and his sons expand their con game with murder.

videos.title: The Search
videos.overview: A young man named Cale may have earned Marshal Dillon's respect, but Tate Gifford says Cale has just ridden off on a stolen horse - Tate's horse.

videos.title: Call Me Dodie
videos.overview: An adolescent escapee from a cruel orphanage knows she has a lot to learn, and she starts learning it from the rough-and-tumble characters and loafers she encounters in Dodge.

videos.title: Quint Asper Comes Home
videos.overview: A half-Comanche has joined his mother's tribe in killing whites to avenge the murder of his father, but Matt sees the good in the man and the chance to re-integrate him, perhaps, into white society.

videos.title: Root Down
videos.overview: Chester may find himself entrapped into marriage with a drifter's daughter who isn't particular about how she lands a husband.

videos.title: Jenny
videos.overview: A bank robber hides out in Dodge, bringing along his girl. While he's gambling away his loot, his girl casts her eye on Matt.

videos.title: Collie's Free
videos.overview: Released after eight bitter years in prison, Collie Patten has difficulty adjusting to the fact that things have inevitably changed with respect to his relationships with his wife, his son, and the citizens of Dodge.

videos.title: The Ditch
videos.overview: A young woman who's heir to her father's land decides to carry out his plan to build a ditch that will impair her neighbors' access to water and perhaps trigger a range war.

videos.title: The Trappers
videos.overview: A trapper leaves his friend dying alone in order to save his own life, only later to stumble across that friend in Dodge, very much alive and wanting him dead.

videos.title: Phoebe Strunk
videos.overview: A band of ne'er-do-wells, led by their mother, see in town a young woman that pleases them and decide to take her by force.

videos.title: The Hunger
videos.overview: Matt and Doc come to the rescue of a farm wife and daughter who essentially are kept as prisoners by the farmer and his son.

videos.title: Abe Blocker
videos.overview: Civilization is moving in on the isolation of a rugged pioneer friend of Matt's, and he starts using lethal force against the settlers encroaching on the land he regards as his.

videos.title: The Way It Is
videos.overview: While Matt is out of town, putting lawman's business ahead of Kitty yet again, a new man in her life has plenty of time and attention to give--perhaps too much attention.

videos.title: Us Haggens
videos.overview: When a boy witnesses his grandfather's murder, it sends Matt looking for a new found companion's uncle.  Festus Haggen is tracking his uncle for killing his twin brother Fergus.  Matt is wary but learns to trust Festus when he's shot and in bad shape.

videos.title: Uncle Sunday
videos.overview: Chester gets a letter from his uncle Sunday, a 'crook', on his upcoming trip to Dodge city. When he arrives with a niece, he finds he has to watch them both or what they have planned just might work, at his expense.

videos.title: False Front
videos.overview: A slick city reporter sets out to prove that even a milquetoast can pass for a feared gunfighter, if a few well-placed tidbits of rumor precede him.

videos.title: Old Comrade
videos.overview: The "town fool" has a chance to change his life when he learns that a famous general, now on his deathbed, believes him to be his long-lost son.

videos.title: Louie Pheeters
videos.overview: The town drunk who saw a man drowned, believes it was dream, until he meets up with the guy who did the drowning.

videos.title: The Renegades
videos.overview: Quint says that white renegades, not Indians, are the cause of recent raids around Dodge. Working shotgun on the stage, he proves his point when he is attacked, then pursued by those renegades. His "Indian" skills save him and a colonel's daughter who has contempt for half-Comanche Quint.

videos.title: Cotter's Girl
videos.overview: A father's dying request is that Matt go to retrieve his daughter. Expecting to find a little girl, Matt finds a near-grown woman, but one who's wild and desperately in need of civilizing.

videos.title: The Bad One
videos.overview: When a young pretty farm woman becomes attracted to and sees some good in a would-be robber, she refuses to identify him.

videos.title: The Cousin
videos.overview: Chance Hopper is Matt's young foster brother, torn between loyalty to Matt and to his partners in crime, who are counting on Chance to divert Matt from their course and make good their getaway.

videos.title: Shona
videos.overview: Gib Dawson brings his beautiful Indian wife, Shona, in to Dodge for treatment of a badly infected hand wound, at a time when racial tensions are running high against the Comanches.

videos.title: Ash
videos.overview: The friendship between business partners is jeopardized when one of them sustains a head injury, changing his personality. The injured man threatens to kill West's character, the fiancé of a young saloon woman.

videos.title: Blind Man's Bluff
videos.overview: Billy Poe is falsely accused of murder by a dying man, and flees to another town while Matt follows him, and encounters dangerous resistance from other men who hate lawmen.

videos.title: Quint's Indian
videos.overview: Two ne'er-do-wells come to town and soon cook up a plot under which half-Comanche blacksmith Quint Asper is framed for the theft of a horse. The atmosphere in Dodge quickly becomes dangerously ugly for Quint.

videos.title: Anybody Can Kill a Marshal
videos.overview: Two men want to rob the bank in Dodge, but are unwilling to try it while Matt lives. A man agrees to accept the job of killing the marshal, attaching some rather peculiar conditions to his acceptance.

videos.title: Two of a Kind
videos.overview: O'Ryan and Finnegan, feuding over a girl they both knew back home, are caught in a legal loophole to take ownership of a mine and land they both own. When Matt is forced in the middle of it, he has to work fast so no one else is hurt.

videos.title: I Call Him Wonder
videos.overview: An orphaned Indian boy latches on to a cowboy in need of work and the two of them find all doors closed to them in Dodge.

videos.title: With a Smile
videos.overview: A rancher's spoiled son believes even after he is convicted of murder that his father's wealth and influence will save him from the hangman.

videos.title: The Far Places
videos.overview: A rancher's widow regrets having spent her life away from the bright lights of a city, and is desperate that her son not share her fate.

videos.title: Panacea Sykes
videos.overview: Kitty welcomes her mentor from New Orleans, but the colorful old lady takes liberties with the truth and with Kitty's possessions.

videos.title: Tell Chester
videos.overview: Chester is smitten with Polly, but she has eyes only for Wade, a man new in town and newly her father's employee. Knowing little about Wade, Polly agrees quickly to marry him, but Chester discovers that Wade already has a wife.

videos.title: Quint-Cident
videos.overview: A woman newly widowed is powerfully attracted to Quint, but when he gently turns her down, she vows to make him pay for scorning a white woman.

videos.title: Old York
videos.overview: Pardoned for his Civil War service, an old outlaw finds his way to Dodge, where there's a lawman who's in his debt.

videos.title: Daddy Went Away
videos.overview: Chester is sweet on a widow dressmaker. When the widow is not only intent on marriage but eager to make changes in Chester as well, he has second thoughts--especially after a talk with her child suggests that the widow may still be a wife.

videos.title: The Odyssey of Jubal Tanner
videos.overview: Aaron, sweet on saloon girl Leah and wanting to make her his wife, is attacked and killed by Colie Fletcher. When Matt goes after him, Colie runs into Jubal Tanner, wounds him, and steals his horse. Jubal, ungrateful to those who help him, meets Leah, and each helps the other's outlook.

videos.title: Jeb
videos.overview: A prized Appaloosa, grazing alone and apparently without owner on the prairie, proves to be the ruin of more than one man.

videos.title: The Quest for Asa Janin
videos.overview: A young man is convicted of killing the saloon girl he wanted for his own. Matt is so sure that the young man is really innocent that he goes on the road after another suspect to prevent an unjust hanging.

videos.title: Kate Heller
videos.overview: A teen-aged boy who robbed and killed to impress a saloon gal is pursued by Matt. The boy waylays Matt and leaves him for dead, then goes home to his grandmother's house to find her nursing Matt back to health.

videos.title: Lover Boy
videos.overview: A charming cowboy apparently is guilty only of breaking hearts until he gets to Dodge, where he finds two women who may make a killer of him.

videos.title: Legends Don't Sleep
videos.overview: A young rascal meets the outlaw idol of his youth, but the aging gunman, newly released from prison, wants only to go straight.

videos.title: Tobe
videos.overview: Hard-luck Tobe, who's lost his farm, gets a job in town with Chester's help and takes up with a saloon gal, not knowing she's on the run from a beau who's a con man and a killer.

videos.title: Easy Come
videos.overview: A mild-looking cowboy discovers that it's easy to steal, and, soon thereafter, that it's easy to kill as well.

videos.title: My Sister's Keeper
videos.overview: A despondent widower goes to work on a farm for two sisters, each of whom finds him fascinating in her own way.

videos.title: Quint's Trail
videos.overview: Quint is hired to escort a family on the first leg of their journey to Oregon. On the way, he learns the reason for their going, a motive that could have repercussions for Quint.

videos.title: Carter Caper
videos.overview: A man with a grudge hits upon the perfect revenge when he spreads the word in Dodge that short-tempered Billy is so good with a gun that he shot down the famous gunfighter, Beau Carter.

videos.title: Ex-Con
videos.overview: On his way to Larned, Matt, feverish, spends the night at an abandoned shack. When he wakes up after losing a day, a recently released convict who swore to kill Matt, is himself found against a wall, dead, unarmed, shot twice, and the murder weapon appears to belong to the marshal.

videos.title: Extradition (1)
videos.overview: When fast-talking killer Charlie Hacker escapes from Matt in Texas, Matt follows him right into Mexico without extradition papers and has to deal with corrupt officials there.

videos.title: Extradition (2)
videos.overview: Matt finally catches up to killer Charlie Hacker in Mexico, and has to make a deal with the greedy Mexican police to get Hacker back to the border, with revengeful Mexican bandits in pursuit.

videos.title: The Magician
videos.overview: A mild old peddler of patent medicines and card tricks arrives in Dodge with his grown daughter, hoping to settle down, but instead they find their worst luck yet, beginning with a card game with a rich man and his spoiled son.

videos.title: Pa Hack's Brood
videos.overview: A repugnant drifter hopes to use his nubile daughter to get his hands on a piece of land.

videos.title: The Glory and the Mud
videos.overview: A retired lawman and showman wants only to settle down with the Dodge seamstress he left behind twenty years ago, but a young whippersnapper hopes to make a name for himself by challenging the aging gun to a duel.

videos.title: Dry Well
videos.overview: It's a test of wills when Quint witnesses a murder and the father of one of the prime suspects lowers Quint into a well to try to force him to promise his silence.

videos.title: Prairie Wolfer
videos.overview: Festus returns to Dodge from wolfing and is hired by the Cattleman's Association to hunt down the wolves killing everyone's cattle. What he finds is that what's been doing the preying may wind him up in prison if he doesn't get Matt's help.

videos.title: Friend
videos.overview: A man carrying a tempting sum of money is attacked from behind by someone who beats him and leaves him for dead. Lucky for the injured man, an old friend of Matt is there to take him in to Doc Adams for mending.

videos.title: Once a Haggen
videos.overview: A man is stabbed after winning in a poker game, and Festus is suspected.

videos.title: No Hands
videos.overview: The Ginnis family causes trouble for Doc Adams, because they hate waiting.  Will Timble gets hurt at The Long Branch.  Doc has to remove Will's hand, which causes Will to leave Dodge because he can't carve wood anymore.

videos.title: May Blossom
videos.overview: Festus' cousin May Blossom arrives from Texas to marry Festus

videos.title: The Bassops
videos.overview: A family in search of a doctor find Matt and his prisoner unconscious and handcuffed to each other on the prairie. The prisoner wakens first and announces that Matt is the condemned man he is transporting for hanging.

videos.title: The Kite
videos.overview: Festus finds a little girl out on the prairie. He learns she saw her mother get killed by a stranger. When he takes her to Dodge, Matt hears she was hiding when this happened but can identify this man who may already be in town.

videos.title: Comanches Is Soft
videos.overview: After some horsing around, Festus breaks some of Quint's equipment. To repair or get anew, they travel to Wichita and meet a saloon girl who tells them she needs to get away from town but her jealous boyfriend is now hot on their trail.

videos.title: Father's Love
videos.overview: A saloon girl spurns a man's advances in Wichita and moves to Dodge, where she becomes a respectable married woman, only to be confronted with her past when she discovers that her rancher husband is the nephew of the man she refused.

videos.title: Now That April's Here
videos.overview: Festus, returning to Dodge after doing some trapping, sees his girl, April, and they argue over a gift she received. Running off, she hides but her perch gives her a bird's eye view of a murder, one no one believes she witnessed but the killers.

videos.title: Caleb
videos.overview: Caleb Marr comes to Dodge in search of a meaningful life after finally acknowledging his failure at farming.

videos.title: Owney Tupper Had a Daughter
videos.overview: To earn money to recover the custody of his daughter, an aging man accepts the job of Dodge's first in-town hangman, work no one else wants.

videos.title: Bently
videos.overview: A dying man confesses to a murder of which he was acquitted, but Chester suspects the man was lying.

videos.title: Kitty Cornered
videos.overview: Competing with Kitty is a fancy new woman in town with plenty of money to build a new saloon and a secret from the past life she recently left behind.

videos.title: The Promoter
videos.overview: Henry Huckaby, a local farmer and fed up with a sore back and an empty belly leaves to seek his fortune in Dodge. After several failed ideas he hits on one that may make him rich but could also cost him his life.

videos.title: Trip West
videos.overview: Given three months to live by a quack peddler of patent medicines, a mousy bank clerk quits his job, withdraws all his money, makes ready to go to California, and falls for a girl who may endanger what time he has remaining.

videos.title: Scot Free
videos.overview: Rob Scot considers himself a man who could stay or go when it came to women. He may have met his match though when a woman he desires, along with her husband, take over an abandoned homestead, and they come to where Rob works to look over some stock.

videos.title: The Warden
videos.overview: A traveling salesman meets up with Bull Foot, an Indian who mainly sells vegetables. When goods are traded for a squaw, he is upset when she runs away and into the arms of Festus, whose mule she steals, only to return home awaiting sale to the next customer.

videos.title: Homecoming
videos.overview: Orval returns from seven years in prison for killing his wife's lover, vowing to reclaim his house and business. Edna tries to goad her new husband and Orval's son into a plot to kill Orval; then her head is turned by a traveling salesman.

videos.title: The Other Half
videos.overview: Jess, Jay's twin, is shot and killed by an unknown assailant while working late at the family business. When a stranger to Dodge is suspected, Matt does his best to track him down and bring him to justice.

videos.title: Journey for Three
videos.overview: Two brothers traveling to California are joined by a third man who soon proves to be a wrong 'un, manhandling and killing a young woman they encounter on the prairie and turning on Quint when he shows up to share his rabbits with them.

videos.title: Blue Heaven
videos.overview: A runaway kid and a wanted man from East Texas team up to first find the kid's mother and second to shake those who have been chasing the man about a murder in Carver County and robbery he just didn't commit.

videos.title: Crooked Mile
videos.overview: Cyrus Degler is determined to keep Quint away from his 19-year old daughter, but no threats or beatings can keep them apart. They are about to leave town to get married when cousin Praylie comes to town bent on putting a stop to their plans any way he has to.

videos.title: Old Man
videos.overview: Having already rescued an old man once, Danny may have to try to save him again when his friend is framed for murder.

videos.title: The Violators
videos.overview: A violent killing appears to be the work of Indians, but Matt doubts it. Someone accuses Quint of it and the solution involves secret motives and revenge in Indian country.

videos.title: Doctor's Wife
videos.overview: There's trouble for Doc Adams, and perhaps for Dodge, when a new doctor and his wife arrive in town and the wife resorts to spreading a nasty rumor about Doc to get the new practice started.

videos.title: Take Her, She's Cheap
videos.overview: When a shiftless farmer offers his daughter to Matt, Matt demurs, but the smitten girl comes after Matt, bringing danger with her.

videos.title: Help Me, Kitty
videos.overview: When a young pregnant woman seeks Kitty's aid in escaping from the child's father, the two women take the stagecoach from Dodge and meet with greater danger.

videos.title: Hung High
videos.overview: As Matt takes a convicted man to Hays City for hanging, Matt and the prisoner are waylaid and the prisoner lynched. Matt is framed for the killing, then arrested by a sergeant with a grudge against him.

videos.title: Jonah Hutchinson
videos.overview: An old rancher returns home after many years in prison, ready to reclaim what is his by any means necessary, including burning out the squatters on his land.

videos.title: Big Man, Big Target
videos.overview: Ellie Merchant, the wife of farmer Joe Merchant, is having a passionate affair with outlaw Pike Beechum. Beechum intends to remove Joe and any other obstacle between him and Ellie.

videos.title: Chicken
videos.overview: Mistakenly hailed as a hero who downed four robbers, a man rethinks his decision to let folks regard him as a gunfighter when protecting the woman he wants calls for a gunman's skill.

videos.title: Innocence
videos.overview: Art and Bob both have an eye on a new girl in town. She works at the Long Branch but only has eyes for the most well-liked man in town. On the eve of their marriage, it all comes to a head and the town is out for blood.

videos.title: Aunt Thede
videos.overview: Festus's ornery aunt arrives, squats on a piece of land, sets up a still, and comes to the rescue of a pair of star-crossed lovers. At the time he appeared in this episode, Howard McNear was appearing on The Andy Griffith Show as regular, Floyd Lawson the town barber.

videos.title: Hammerhead
videos.overview: Festus takes part in a horse race in which big money is at stake, tempting some to sabotage the race in order to make sure of the outcome.

videos.title: Double Entry
videos.overview: Matt's old friend comes to town, announcing plans to settle down and start a business, but the business he has in mind involves dishonesty and perhaps murder.

videos.title: Run, Sheep, Run
videos.overview: The body of a no-good man is found in his burning store on the same night as the sudden disappearance of the nice couple he cheated out of the money for their ranch.

videos.title: Deputy Festus
videos.overview: On their way out of town, some cousins of Festus come across a badly injured man whom they assume is dead, so they flee, pursued by Festus, who believes his cousins attacked the man.

videos.title: One Killer on Ice
videos.overview: Anderson, a stylish bounty hunter, rides into Dodge City. He informs Matt that his partner has a wanted criminal at an ice house. The locale is a two-day ride from Dodge; Anderson wants Matt's help to bring the criminal in. The outlaw's brother intends to go gunning for Matt and Anderson. There's also a twist: Matt finds out Anderson didn't tell him the truth about what happened. Both Anderson's partner and the outlaw lie dead at the ice house.

videos.title: Chief Joseph
videos.overview: Chief Joseph has come to town suffering from pneumonia. When he and his party are refused lodging at the hotel, a stranger steps in offering his room. Local sentiment is against this and like a boiling over teapot, trouble begins to brew.

videos.title: Circus Trick
videos.overview: A circus family comes to town and charms the populace, who don't know the family's real stock in trade is larceny.

videos.title: Song for Dying
videos.overview: The head of the Lukens clan blames Martin Kellums for not helping his young bride during a difficult childbirth when the doctor was away. When Kellums runs to Dodge, Matt does his best to keep everyone safe including the local citizens.

videos.title: Winner Take All
videos.overview: Two brothers quarrel to the death over a woman, and as the survivor flees with her, pursued by Matt, the killing may not be over.

videos.title: Eliab's Aim
videos.overview: The goofy nephew of Festus, Eliab Haggen, comes to Dodge with the hope of shooting off a tiny piece of his ear, because Festus bit off a piece of his dad's ear years ago in a fight.

videos.title: Thursday's Child
videos.overview: Kitty welcomes her mentor to town, but her friend is burdened by a secret: she's here to deliver the child of her outlaw son, a man willing to take his own mother hostage.
